how_to_edit: Chance that a defeated enemy drops something you can pick up. Kept low to begin with; unlocks raise 'drop luck', which multiplies every chance below.
chances: per kill, rolled rarest first; an enemy drops at most one thing. 0.05 = 5%.
enemy_multipliers: scales all chances for some enemies (elites drop more, swarming sporelings less). Keys not listed use 'default'.
active_item_drops: separate elite and boss roll using the current class pool. Picking one up fills the active slot and fully charges it.
gold_amount: coins in a gold drop: min-max, plus per_floor for each floor deeper.
luck_cap: the most drop luck can multiply chances by.
